ServeHub motion system and its rationale

nodes.label: Motion
nodes.rationale: Motion explains a change, never decorates; frequent actions (navigation, keyboard, dark mode) never animate.

nodes.label: Sign-in Hero
nodes.rationale: The one authored entrance; finishes in ~2s, never blocks the form, inside the app motion stays limited to feedback.

nodes.label: Product Principles
nodes.rationale: Every prompt rule visible in the UI; show match/waitlist/rejection reasons; one main action per screen; prefer cancelling to deleting.

nodes.label: Data and layout (from the worst-case test, `?data=worst`)
nodes.norm_label: data and layout (from the worst-case test, `?data=worst`)

frontmatter.target: redesign prototype (sign-in, volunteer dashboard, admin impact)

nodes.label: Accessibility notes shown in the mockups
nodes.norm_label: accessibility notes shown in the mockups

frontmatter.name: ServeHub
frontmatter.description: A volunteer desk for Riverside Community Partners that shows the reason behind every rule.

nodes.label: Validation that checks meaning, not just format
nodes.norm_label: validation that checks meaning, not just format

nodes.label: Expressive entry screens, calm working screens
nodes.norm_label: expressive entry screens, calm working screens
nodes.rationale: ServeHub is a nonprofit tool and an FBLA judged demo, not a marketing site; hero borrowed from Cardova landing page.

nodes.label: Never rewrite source with PowerShell Get-Content/Set-Content
nodes.norm_label: never rewrite source with powershell get-content/set-content
nodes.rationale: They mangle UTF-8 characters like the middle dot and curly apostrophe into mojibake.

nodes.label: Stress-test mode gated on VITE_STRESS_TEST
nodes.rationale: Gating on import.meta.env.DEV showed the switch in every npm run dev, which is how the app gets demoed.

nodes.label: Figma screens (Login, Volunteer Dashboard, Browse, Help, Admin Impact, Hour Approvals)
nodes.norm_label: figma screens (login, volunteer dashboard, browse, help, admin impact, hour approvals)

nodes.label: Figma Tokens page (Color Light/Dark, Scale)
nodes.rationale: Starter plan allows one mode per collection, so light and dark are separate collections.

nodes.label: Creative North Star: The Volunteer Desk
nodes.norm_label: creative north star: the volunteer desk
nodes.rationale: Show the rule right where it applies: capacity bars, waitlist counts, match reasons.

nodes.label: Redesign Prototype Critique (22/40)
nodes.rationale: Dual-agent review scored the redesign prototype 22/40; P1s: missing Help/Certificates/Audit nav, too much green, admin screen upside down, weak focus ring.

nodes.label: Admin 'Needs you' strip
nodes.rationale: Admin screen was upside down (chart outweighed actions); inline approve / send back strip moved actionable items first.

nodes.label: Smoke Test Page (deliberately flawed UI)
nodes.rationale: Low contrast text, missing img alt, 20px icon button, unlabeled input, heavy shadow so audits have findings.

nodes.label: Every choice needs a one-line reason for judges
nodes.norm_label: every choice needs a one-line reason for judges

nodes.label: The Flat Desk Rule
nodes.rationale: No shadow at rest; a shadow means 'this floats' or 'you can click this'.

nodes.label: Direction contract (thesis, own-world, story)
nodes.rationale: A working volunteer desk where every rule shows its reason in place; refuses the gray SaaS template where state is hidden behind clicks.

nodes.label: Signature move: capacity and match made visible
nodes.norm_label: signature move: capacity and match made visible

nodes.label: The Three Signals Rule
nodes.rationale: Green = go/done, amber = waiting, red = wrong; anything else is zinc.

nodes.label: Recommended for you scoring (skills 50, availability 30, interests 20)
nodes.norm_label: recommended for you scoring (skills 50, availability 30, interests 20)

nodes.label: Electron + React + Tailwind + shadcn/ui + node:sqlite stack
nodes.norm_label: electron + react + tailwind + shadcn/ui + node:sqlite stack
nodes.rationale: node:sqlite avoids native compile; sign-ups in BEGIN IMMEDIATE so two people can't take the last spot.

nodes.label: Four-layer renderer/preload/ipc/services/db flow
nodes.rationale: Each layer only talks to its neighbor; renderer has no Node or DB access, preload exposes one window.api.call.

nodes.label: Sign up request end to end
nodes.norm_label: sign up request end to end

nodes.label: Validation runs twice (zod in UI and service)
nodes.norm_label: validation runs twice (zod in ui and service)
nodes.rationale: The UI is not trusted; meaning checks (full, ended, overlap) live only in services.

nodes.label: Access control enforced in services
nodes.rationale: UI guards only decide what to show; requireUser/requireAdmin/requireVolunteer guard every service.
